findings.evidence: Lines 188-196: `Model.zero` is used only via `Model.zero_H` to turn agreement into `p.eval x = 0`; nothing else in the proof depends on the first model being zero. The same `Model.ofPolynomial p` profile added to any `M₁` gives the same conclusion.
findings.fix: State it for an arbitrary model: `∀ (M₁ : Model Flavor), Assumptions M₁ → (∀ i xi t, IntegrableOn (fun x => M₁.H i x xi t) (Icc (-1) 1)) → ∀ N, ∃ M₂, Assumptions M₂ ∧ … ∧ (∀ n ≤ N, mellinMomentH M₁ n i xi t = mellinMomentH M₂ n i xi t) ∧ ¬ (… =ᵐ …)`, with `M₂.H = M₁.H + Icc 0 1 |>.indicator p.eval` (at `|ξ| ≤ 1`). `Assumptions` and integrability transfer because the added term is supported in `[0,1]` and vanishes for `1 < |ξ|`; the moments add `0` by `integral_add`. Derive the current `Model.zero` pair from it if still wanted.
findings.issue: `exists_models_forall_le_mellinMomentH_eq_and_H_not_ae_eq` is the special case at `M₁ = Model.zero` of the statement the docstring actually advertises ("an extraction of `H` from finitely many measured moments is an inverse problem"), which is about an arbitrary candidate distribution, not about zero. `Model.zero` enters the proof only through `Model.zero_H … = 0` in `heval` (line 192).

findings.evidence: upstream/TauCeti/TauCeti/Probability/Moments/VanishingMoments.lean:53 `variable {ν : Measure ℝ}` and :229 `theorem ae_eq_zero_of_forall_moment_eq_zero (g : ℝ → ℝ) … g =ᵐ[ν] 0`; upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LocallyIntegrable.lean:740 `IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul … (hg' : IntegrableOn g' K μ) (hK : IsCompact K)`.
findings.fix: Add `{μ : Measure ℝ}` and state `IntegrableOn f (Icc a b) μ`, `∫ x in Icc a b, x ^ n * f x ∂μ = 0`, `f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (Icc a b)] 0`. The three proof terms are unchanged; the GPD consumers instantiate at `volume` by default. Leave `polynomialMomentsIcc` and `not_eval_ae_eq_zero_of_ne_zero` at `volume`, where generalising would need extra typeclass hypotheses.
findings.issue: `integrableOn_Icc_pow_mul`, `ae_eq_zero_of_forall_setIntegral_Icc_pow_mul_eq_zero` (line 79) and `ae_eq_of_forall_setIntegral_Icc_pow_mul_eq` (line 86) are fixed to Lebesgue measure, although every input is measure-general: `TauCeti.ae_eq_zero_of_forall_moment_eq_zero` has `variable {ν : Measure ℝ}` and `IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul` carries `μ`. The Hausdorff moment problem against a weight on a compact interval (TauCeti's own motivating example, Chebyshev on `[-1,1]`) is excluded for no reason.

summary: The mathematics file is correctly layered on TauCeti, but two statements sit below their natural level: the GPD sharpness theorem is hard-wired to perturbations of `Model.zero` rather than of an arbitrary model, and the whole determinacy chain is fixed to `volume` although the TauCeti input and every Mathlib lemma used are measure-general.
